statusText: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES / orange. Tail remains elevated because the technology-led advance is broadly aligned, while the available delayed NQ reference remains below its session high and does not verify an uninterrupted no-retracement path.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: BLOCK_NEW_BASE_ENTRIES. Current evidence supports elevated, not high, Tail: cash equities and technology breadth remain strong, but measurable mean reversion and limited fresh granular NQ path data cap the assessment.
headline: Technology breadth stays strongly aligned, while NQ evidence still shows room for mean reversion
body: Nasdaq cash equities are up strongly and fresh supplementary breadth shows all eight tracked megacaps and all seven tracked semiconductor names positive. Reuters reports lower oil and Treasury yields alongside the technology rally. The latest independently retrieved delayed December NQ reference is 30,238.50 versus a 30,275.00 session high, so fresh one-way extension is not verified.

lookbackSummary: Tail was low through most of Sunday and early Monday, moved to WATCH as NQ strengthened, entered the elevated band before the U.S. cash session, briefly reached 35% after strong continuation, and then eased as a measurable pullback developed while technology leadership remained strong.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is 31% / elevated. Broad technology and semiconductor participation confirm a strong trend, but the available delayed NQ reference remains below the session high. Power hour is the main late-session checkpoint; later Tail de-escalates unless fresh directional extension develops with shallow or failed pullbacks.

forecast.analysis: The current hour remains a strong technology-led trend, but independently retrieved delayed NQ is still below its session high. Fresh breadth is broadly aligned, while the verified pullback argues against treating the path as uninterrupted extension.
drivers: Nasdaq cash index remains strongly higher
All 8 tracked megacaps are positive in fresh supplementary breadth
Delayed NQ remains below the session high

forecast.analysis: Conditional: At the cash close, elevated Tail persists only if the late-session advance remains one-way into the bell. A close with two-way rotation or distance from the high would support rapid de-escalation despite the strong daily gain.

Conditional: Early post-close risk is expected to ease from the cash-session peak. WATCH remains appropriate only if after-hours price discovery extends the same directional move without meaningful retracement.

Conditional: The base case shifts back below WATCH as U.S. cash liquidity fades. Tail would re-expand only on a fresh catalyst that produces renewed directional extension rather than ordinary overnight volatility.
drivers: No scheduled tier-one U.S. release in this hour
Fresh catalyst would be required for renewed extension

forecast.analysis: Conditional: Overnight structure is expected to be less directional after the U.S. close. Stress remains high because macro and geopolitical uncertainty persist, but no specific one-way price-path catalyst is scheduled for this hour.

Conditional: The overnight base case remains orderly and below WATCH. Tail would rise only if futures develop sustained directional efficiency with shallow pullbacks or if a new geopolitical or policy catalyst emerges.

Conditional: This hour carries low conditional Tail absent a new catalyst. Generic overnight volatility is treated primarily as Stress unless futures begin holding near an extreme and repeatedly extend after failed retracements.

forecast.analysis: Conditional: The cash-open hour is the main directional checkpoint. Tail reaches the top of WATCH conditionally if the opening auction preserves a one-way regime; meaningful rotation after the open would reduce it.

Conditional: This hour combines early cash-session structure with scheduled remarks from John Williams and Philip Jefferson. Elevated Tail applies only if the observed market path becomes persistently directional; the speeches themselves primarily raise Stress.

Conditional: After the scheduled remarks, the base case returns to WATCH if price discovery is two-way. Tail would remain elevated only if the cash-session move keeps extending after failed retracements.
Conditional: Mid-session conditional Tail eases as event timing passes. Persistent one-way structure would keep risk higher, but ordinary consolidation supports a WATCH state.
Conditional: The final forecast hour remains WATCH in the base case. Tail would fall below WATCH with orderly consolidation, or rise if a fresh catalyst restores sustained directional efficiency.
